tier_label: Verification of the finished oil - cold flow and volatility

pour_point.calculation_note: The 'Pour Point, °C' row prints 'L-40.0' for S-8 (Super 60N). The meaning of the 'L' prefix is not defined in any S-OIL document reviewed (DL2-12392/12393/12394.pdf, the S-OIL product catalog, the S-OIL Lube Base Oil web page), so no numeric value is assigned (2026-10 audit).

open_questions: API Group for historical S-OIL S-8 (Super 60N) remains unverified.
Grade-specific Super 8 SDS composition and CAS number require direct verification.
Specific gravity 0.8719 at 15/4°C (ASTM D1298) is dimensionless and must not be transcribed as absolute density.

Pour point is printed as L-40.0 °C (ASTM D5950); qualifier or encoding remains ambiguous. Numeric value deliberately left null. No S-OIL legend defining the 'L' prefix was found in the archived sheets, the S-OIL catalog or the S-OIL web page (2026-10 audit); confirm with S-OIL whether 'L-40.0' means 'below -40.0 °C'.
MRV apparent viscosity and MRV yield stress have not been verified for S-8; no MRV test temperature is available.
Noack volatility, CCS viscosity, saturates and aromatics remain unverified.
Final reconciliation between DL2-12392.pdf and grade-specific Super 8 SDS pending.
